# Zhang Xiangqian's unified field theory and US 12,417,870

Supplied by the user on 2026-10-24 as links, with the request to rebuild the patent's apparatus in
3D from real physics and to find the physics it needs. The links, verbatim:

- https://zhangxiangqian.me/files/(For%20Investment,%20please%20contact)%20US_Invention_Patent_12417870_Method_and_Device_for_Driving_Movement_by_Gravitational_Field.pdf
- https://github.com/thanhthuan270127-prog/Unified-Field-Theory
- https://github.com/thanhthuan270127-prog/Five-Constants-Normalization
- https://github.com/thanhthuan270127-prog/Collaborative-Papers-Zhang-Xiangqian-Xu-Yuchuan
- https://github.com/thanhthuan270127-prog/Unified-Field-Theory-Zhang-Xiangqian
- https://unifiedfieldtheory.vercel.app/en/theory/overview

None of the repositories has a licence, so nothing from them is copied here. Below is what each
source holds, in our words, with its numbers and formulas cited as facts. The review is in
[`2026-10-24-zhang-unified-field-theory-review.md`](2026-10-24-zhang-unified-field-theory-review.md).

## The sources

| Source | What it holds |
|---|---|
| **US 12,417,870 B1**, "Method and device for driving movement of target object by gravitational field generated by varying electromagnetic field"; Xiangqian Zhang, Zhongqiang Xiao, Xiang Li; filed 2025-03-22, granted 2025-09-16 | One embodiment and no equations, mechanism or measured force. A 10 cm vacuum tank at an unspecified "near vacuum"; a non-magnetic polyethylene (plastic) ball on a fine cotton thread inside; an upper coil fed by a 2GF-200 kV/5 mA pulsed DC supply at about 50 kV and 10 µA; a lower coil grounded; coils of silicone wire 10 mm across with a 1.5 mm copper core; the wires between the coils left open, uninsulated at the break, and staggered (its FIG. 3). |
| *Unified Field Theory*, 7th edition (Chinese PDF, in the `Unified-Field-Theory` repository) | The 18 core equations, the derivations, and chapter 37 on the experiments. The ball rig there: tank 10 cm across, laid horizontally; a red polyethylene ball of 0.35 g; coils 8 cm across and 12 cm tall above and below the tank; supply a 2 kW DC source at 52 V driving a 3 kW ZVS board at 30 kHz into a 550:1 transformer (10 kV), then a 10-stage multiplier to 100 kV pulsed DC. The ball starts turning at switch-on and turns faster at switch-off (first seen 2024-03-01). The flake rig (first seen 2023-11-02): two wire ends 6 cm apart in a plexiglass and later a silicone tube, a light flake on a thread around the tube at the gap, about 50 kV DC; at switch-on the flake moves toward the positive wire, and with the leads swapped it again moves toward the positive wire. Also reported to work in vacuum. |
| The same repository's paper (DOCX) | The derivation of `e = −c²ω²r³/g` from `m = −r²a/g` with `a = ω²r` and `e = mc²√(1 − v²/c²)`. |
| `Collaborative-Papers-Zhang-Xiangqian-Xu-Yuchuan` (24 PDFs) | Read in full: **"An experiment based on the generation of positive and negative gravitational fields by the accelerated motion of positive charges"** (Zhang & Xu), which derives `E_θ/e_r = −A×R/c²` by the kink-field construction and reports a nylon ring (radii 20 and 50 mm, height 50 mm) on a shielded electronic balance around a hollow 150 kV cable with two 1.5 mm copper wires inserted from its ends, 50 mm apart, at 55 kV and under 30 µA: 0.83–1.20 g lighter with the upper wire positive, 0.76–1.08 g heavier with it negative, back to zero when switched off; with seven such cables round an alumina tube (ring radii 25 and 50 mm), 6.17–8.36 g lighter and 5.47–7.63 g heavier. And **"Gravitational field and object motion generated by electromagnetic changes"** (Zhang & Xu, DOI 10.20146/j.cnki.1672-4224.2025.01.016): a gapped amorphous toroid (130/190 mm, 30 mm tall, 18 mm gap, 400 turns) at 50 Hz, 10–50 A, 0.1–0.5 T in the gap; epoxy board, paper, ceramic, a leaf, aluminium plate and pork skin hung in the gap all move, and also with 20–60 V DC at switching; proposed `∇×A = B/k` with `k` not given. The other 22 papers (constants, quantum, brain, neutrinos) were listed, not read. |
| `Unified-Field-Theory-Zhang-Xiangqian` (Markdown notes) | The experiment log: the 2023 flake rig with the materials tried (glass, ceramic, copper, iron, paper, plastic, PVA, bakelite, aerogel); a 2025-09-20 Michelson interferometer run by a Dr Huang Shan with a fringe shift at the pulse, read as a micrometre change of optical path; the patent, here dated 2025-10-17 and titled differently. The definitions `g = dC/dt` and `q = dm/dt`. |
| `Five-Constants-Normalization` | `4π²r³c²/(T²Ghν) = 1`, from `m = ω²r³/G`, `E = mc²` and `E = hν`. |
| unifiedfieldtheory.vercel.app (English) | The 18 equations: the master equation `P = (C − V)M` and its time derivative split into four forces; `B = V×E/c²`; `R = Ct`; `dB/dt = −A×E/c² − V×(dE/dt)/c²`; `F = (C − V) dm/dt`. Claims that fields can move faster than light, that a mass-variation was seen on a balance (April 2024), that the effect appears at 80 V/30 A (late 2024), a comparison with Pais's Navy patents, and a call for independent replication. |
